verdicts.observation: The translation drops the qualifier "with a melee attack": 每次你击中对手时 says any hit triggers the effect. At engine@624a6732, the Exploit Weakness trigger is only in the melee attack flow, game/modules/tome/class/interface/Combat.lua:975 (hitted and isTalentActive(T_EXPLOIT_WEAKNESS)). Ranged hits do not reduce resistance, so the text should say melee attack (近战攻击击中).

The source says "this specific effect", but the translation generalizes it to 完全免疫状态异常的几率, and the title 状态异常免疫几率 overlaps with TOOLTIP_STATUS_IMMUNE (Status resistance) on the line above. CharacterSheet.lua:1298/1307 use TOOLTIP_SPECIFIC_IMMUNE as the fallback tooltip for a single named immunity row, so the text should mean the chance to fully resist that specific effect (该特定效果).

The target adds hard line breaks that are not in the source, in the middle of words and sentences: 通常不
会, 可以
根据, 还存
在. done.lua:20-31 has no such breaks, and in-game the text will show these broken lines verbatim. This violates the newline invariant; the breaks should be removed so the paragraphs match the source.
